protocol.sample: All 5-9 car races with exact 3連単 price book and verified results 2021-2026H1
protocol.formation_masks: 20 historical TRAIN-only ranked models held FIXED
protocol.all_comparisons: Same race/tickets; change ONLY weights, or skip if no estimated +EV
protocol.train_corrections: 2021-2023 all priced races, posterior correction for 27 rank-cell bias
protocol.equal: 1000 yen distributed as evenly as units permit
protocol.dutch: More money on lower odds in inverse proportion to odds
protocol.high_odds: More money on high odds proportional to sqrt(odds)
protocol.learned_residual: More money on historical market error factor raised to power 3
protocol.positive_ev_only: Buy only ticket(s) with modeled 5%+ net expected profit, skip races without; model uncertainty remains
protocol.historical_price: FINAL odds not T-minus-15, training and verification time-separated but previously inspected in other studies
protocol.no_modification: No existing predictor or live buying policies changed

warnings: Reallocating cash cannot turn all negative-EV ticket options positive.
Fixed 1000 yen race budget differs from previous flat 100 yen per point; compare ROI, not raw profit.
Training on the same outcomes used to discover candidate masks creates overfit risk.
An ex-post final odds book is not a pre-purchase executable quote.
Positive-EV calibration is hypothetical and needs market close risk/bet-timing verification.
